caption: The drawing features a mechanical toy consisting of a rectangular yellow base with the words "TRICK DOG" written in black capital letters on the front. On top of the base, there is a red barrel with black horizontal bands and an image of a dog on its side. Next to the barrel stands a human figure dressed in a yellow outfit with red accents and a pointed hat; the figure has one hand on its hip and the other hand raised, holding a circular hoop upright. To the right of the human figure, there is a small black dog standing on all fours. The surface of the base is brown, and the overall composition is centered against a plain, light-colored background. The artist's signature "Geo J. File" appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Toy Bank: Trick Dog
